categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the design, research and development, production and sales of magnetic components. Main products include network transformers, chip inductors, and power magnetic components. The company serves multiple application fields including network communications, new energy vehicles, industrial power supplies, security equipment, and consumer electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core technologies including filter welding methods, thermal compression welding technology, network transformer new sealing technology, chip inductor technology, and three-in-one transformer magnetic integration technology. Production methods include self-developed and introduced automated production equipment, with increasing automation levels in manufacturing processes. The company has achieved automated production for network transformers and various power magnetic components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known companies such as Gongxin Co., Ltd., ZTE, Xiaomi, Geely Weivue, BYD, Weimais, Bitmain (domestic), and Foxconn, Delta Electronics, Zhibang Technology, Mingtai Technology, Zhonglei Electronics, Sakhem (overseas). The company serves network communications, new energy vehicles, industrial power supplies, security equipment, and consumer electronics markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Dongguan, Guangdong Province. It has established subsidiaries and offices including Hong Kong Misun Technology Limited (wholly-owned subsidiary), Shanghai branch, and Shenzhen branch. The company also conducts overseas business with significant international customer base, with overseas revenue representing approximately 23.51% of total revenue in 2023.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs and manufactures magnetic components that are supplied to downstream customers in network communications, automotive, industrial power, and consumer electronics sectors. The company controls the complete value chain from R&D and design through production and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technology innovation and product development as its primary growth driver. Key R&D focuses include: developing high-speed Ethernet network transformers (25G Base-T, 5G Base-T, 10G Base-T), automotive-grade magnetic components for new energy vehicles, integrated magnetic components, chip inductors and molded inductors, and automated production technology. The company invests approximately 5.14% of revenue in R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of magnetic components to customers, with a direct sales to distribution ratio of approximately 91.41% to 8.59%. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, which occurs at the point of delivery for domestic sales and upon export clearance for overseas sales. The company also operates a VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) sales model with certain customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is an early entrant in the magnetic components industry with over 20 years of experience. It positions itself as a technology and quality leader with advantages in design innovation, manufacturing automation, product quality control, and customer service. The company competes with other magnetic component manufacturers through superior product performance, reliability, and responsiveness to customer needs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 435.72 million yuan, down 10.59% from 487.31 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 54.99 million yuan in 2023, down 17.76% from 66.87 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 734.01 million yuan at year-end 2023. The company went public on January 24, 2024, issuing 11.095149 million shares.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive product portfolio covering network transformers, power magnetic components, and chip inductors with specifications from 6PIN to 96PIN; (2) advanced automation and manufacturing efficiency enabling high quality and low cost; (3) rapid product development and customization capabilities; (4) strong technical expertise in magnetic integration and high-frequency applications; (5) reliable quality management systems and certifications (ISO9001, IATF16949, QC080000); (6) responsive customer service with dedicated FAE support and comprehensive technical solutions.
